system.effect: Cures all addictions; you gain three levels of dehydration, hunger, and exhaustion.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
This miracle drug comes in an inhaler. You can spend 4 AP to consume it. When you do; you become cured of all addictions. However, you gain three levels of dehydration, hunger, and exhaustion.

system.effect: Stops a disease; the exact effect depends on the disease you contracted.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
This bottled medicine can stop diseases. How it affects the disease you contracted is dependent on the disease. You can consume this bottled medicine with 5 AP.
New in v2.1, alongside the new Diseases chapter.

system.effect: Resistance to poison damage dealt to your hit points for 6 hours.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can consume this bottled medicine with 5 AP. If you do; you become resistant to poison damage dealt to your hit points for the next 6 hours.

(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can consume this small pill with 3 AP. If you do; you have night vision for the next 3 hours.
Load is printed as “x10 = 1”: ten of them together weigh 1 load, so the per-item load is 0.1.

system.effect: Three uses of Tourniquet, Pain Killer, Stitch Wounds or Set Bone.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
This bag includes specialized tools, bandages, gauze, and healing serums to provide medical aid. You can use this kit on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. When you use it, choose one of the following actions.
- Tourniquet. Spend 6 AP and remove up to two levels of bleeding.
- Pain Killer. Spend 6 AP to heal a dying creature 1 hit point.
- Stitch Wounds. Spend 10 minutes and heal a creature with a number of hit points equal to double their healing rate + your medicine skill bonus.
- Set Bone. Spend 10 minutes and a creature with the Broken Arm or Broken Leg condition may remove it.
After you have used three of these actions, the doctor’ bag supplies are used and it no longer functions.
AP cost varies by action (6 AP, or 10 minutes), so the AP field is 0.

system.effect: Cures one addiction of your choice; you gain one level of dehydration, hunger, and exhaustion.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
A small pill typically found in a tin with up to 5. You can spend 4 AP to consume it. When you do; you become cured of one addiction of your choice. However, you gain one level of dehydration, hunger, and exhaustion.
Load is printed as “x10 = 1”: ten of them together weigh 1 load, so the per-item load is 0.1.

system.effect: One use of Tourniquet, Pain Killer or Stitch Wounds.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can use this kit on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. When you use it, choose one of the following actions.
- Tourniquet. Spend 6 AP and remove up to two levels of bleeding.
- Pain Killer. Spend 6 AP to heal a dying creature 1 hit point.
- Stitch Wounds. Spend 10 minutes and heal a creature with a number of hit points equal to double their healing rate + your medicine skill bonus.
After you have used one of these actions, the first aid kit’s supplies are used and it no longer functions.
AP cost varies by action (6 AP, or 10 minutes), so the AP field is 0.

system.effect: Heals half the target's healing rate at the start of each of their turns for three rounds.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can spend 6 AP to use this medicinal item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a human, mutant, abomination, animal, or insect; at the start of each of their turns they heal a number of hit points equal to half their healing rate (rounded down). After healing for three rounds, the effects cease. Ghouls, robots, and gen-2 synths are unaffected by healing powder.
The healing rate multiple (0.5) is applied once per round for three rounds.

system.effect: Removes two levels of radiation; the target gains one level of thirst.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can spend 15 minutes to use this medicinal item on yourself or a creature within 5 feet of you. At the end of the hour, the affected creature removes two levels of radiation but gains one level of thirst.
Use time is 15 minutes, not AP, so the AP field is 0. The book says “15 minutes” to use but “at the end of the hour” for the effect; transcribed as printed.

system.effect: Removes one level of radiation; the target gains one level of thirst.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can spend 15 minutes to use this medicinal item on yourself or a creature within 5 feet of you. At the end of the hour, the affected creature removes one level of radiation but gains one level of thirst.
Use time is 15 minutes, not AP, so the AP field is 0. The book says “15 minutes” to use but “at the end of the hour” for the effect; transcribed as printed.

system.effect: Your radiation DC decreases by 2 for 3 hours.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can consume this small pill with 3 AP. If you do; your radiation DC decreases by 2 for the next 3 hours. You can consume a total of three Rad-X at one time to gain their benefits, if you consume more than three you do not gain any additional benefits.
Load is printed as “x10 = 1”: ten of them together weigh 1 load, so the per-item load is 0.1.

system.effect: Heals a robot or gen-2 synth hit points equal to half their healing rate.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
The RobCo Quick Fix-it 1.0 is a healing stim but for robots! You can spend 4 AP to use this item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a robot or gen-2 synth; they heal a number of hit points equal to half their healing rate.

system.effect: Heals a robot or gen-2 synth hit points equal to their healing rate.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
The RobCo Quick Fix-it 2.0 is the new and improved healing stim but for robots! You can spend 4 AP to use this item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a robot or gen-2 synth; they heal a number of hit points equal to their healing rate.

system.effect: Heals a robot or gen-2 synth hit points equal to double their healing rate.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
The Extreme Damages RobCo Quick Fix-it 2.0 is a healing stim but for robots in severe cases of major damages! You can spend 4 AP to use this item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a robot or gen-2 synth; they heal a number of hit points equal to double their healing rate.

system.effect: Heals hit points equal to your healing rate.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can spend 4 AP to use this medicinal item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a human, mutant, abomination, animal, or insect; they heal a number of hit points equal to their healing rate. If that creature is a ghoul; they heal a number of hit points equal to half their healing rate.
v2.1 dropped “gen-2 synth” from this list (v2.0 included it); Stimpak (Diluted) and Super Stimpak still list gen-2 synth, so the omission may be a book slip.

system.effect: Heals hit points equal to half your healing rate.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
You can spend 4 AP to use this medicinal item on yourself or another creature so long as they are next to you. If that creature is a human, mutant, gen-2 synth, abomination, animal, or insect; they heal a number of hit points equal to half their healing rate. If that creature is a ghoul; they heal a number of hit points equal to a quarter of their healing rate.

system.effect: Heals hit points equal to double your healing rate.

If that creature is a human, mutant, gen-2 synth, abomination, animal, or insect; they heal a number of hit points equal to double their healing rate. If that creature is a ghoul; they heal a number of hit points equal to their healing rate.

system.effect: Automatically applies a stimpak the first time on a turn you drop to half hit points or lower.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
When your hit points are equal to or lower than half their maximum (rounded down) for the first time on a turn; you automatically gain the effects of a stimpak.
Triggers automatically, so the AP field is 0. Healing follows Stimpak, including the ghoul half-rate clause.

system.effect: Automatically applies a super stimpak the first time on a turn you drop to half hit points or lower.
system.description:
(pg 86-87) Medicine. Non-addictive.
When your hit points are equal to or lower than half their maximum (rounded down) for the first time on a turn; you automatically gain the effects of a super stimpak.
Triggers automatically, so the AP field is 0. Healing follows Super Stimpak, including the ghoul half-rate clause.

system.effect: Your Guns skill bonus increases by 1 until you rest.
system.description:
(pg 88) Skill magazine.
Your Guns skill bonus increases by 1 until you rest.
Reading a skill magazine takes a number of minutes equal to 5 minus your Intelligence ability modifier; if this number is reduced to 0 you can read the skill magazine with 6 AP.
Once you read an issue of a skill magazine you can no longer gain its benefits. Keep track of which issues you’ve read. After you read five different issues of the same magazine, your associated skill bonus permanently increases by 1.
The table has no Cost or Load column: each magazine typically costs around 50 caps and has a load of 2 (GM’s discretion).
